question: Does the single second/next anticommuting witness in each J7N cell admit an exact conditional one-site next-charge law without enumerating the full next public distribution?
role: Bounded algebraic reduction prerequisite; no complete next law, information gain, risk, policy, or noisy-schedule claim
source_basis: J7M complete full-binary second public laws at one selected first record
J7N fixed-future four-cell flux, eligibility, and unique anticommuting witness
J6L/J6M paper-normalized periodic projector geometry and vacuum orbit
J6N/J7D frozen conjugated-star and commutator algebra

model.physical_and_public_boundary: Same ideal L=2 D4 vacuum orbit, private initial red-X error [0,4,3], selected positive full-binary first record, relation-free public actions [0] and [1,30,32,34,35], complete action-conditioned second record, and matched private later-fault keys [0] and [4] as J7N. Private errors, future faults, supports, operators, and proofs are not decoder inputs.
model.algebra: Each eligible full-binary second-star measurement is a Hermitian involution A with projector P_a=(I+aA)/2, a in {+1,-1}; each eligible next witness B is likewise an involution. If same-round second projectors commute and AB=-BA, then P_a B P_a=0. For every positive complete second prefix, P(next witness outcome +1 | prefix)=P(-1 | prefix)=1/2, regardless of first-state amplitudes. This says nothing about other next sites or their joint law.
model.uncertainty: Exact symbolic identity checked against frozen bitmask operator algebra and all 34 positive second records; no stochastic uncertainty

branches: both public actions crossed with both frozen later faults
all eligible second-star same-round pairs commute and witness operators square to identity
all positive full-binary second prefixes include the measured second witness and yield symbolic fair next-site-1 conditional law

competing_outcomes.identity_valid: Unique witness, commuting second block, involutions, and full second record all reconcile: next site 1 is exactly fair for every positive prefix in every cell; this only closes the one-site witness marginal.
competing_outcomes.identity_invalid: Any operator, public-record, or source-pin gate fails; do not infer the next-site law.
competing_outcomes.joint_unresolved: Even if the one-site identity holds, other next sites and correlations may differ across actions; no complete next-law or risk comparison is licensed.

acceptance: Six source/result pins pass before and after
All four fixed action/future cells replay J7N's unique witness and matched public flux
Every eligible same-round second operator pair commutes and witness operators are Hermitian involutions in the frozen bitmask algebra
All 68 positive action/future second-prefix checks retain complete public records, measured witness bits and positive mass
The projector identity is explicitly applied only to next site 1, with exact 1/2 conditional probabilities; no Born moments, joint next law, stochastic work, policy arms, bootstrap or caller edit
stop_rule: Fail closed on any pin, geometry, commutation, involution, public-prefix, CPU, pair-count or prefix-count gate. No brute-force next joint law or budget increase in this tick.
